title: celastrus orbiculatus var. cuneatus
intro: Celastrus orbiculatus var. cuneatus, commonly known as the Schisandra, is a plant species native to East Asia, classified in the family Celastraceae. This plant is valued for its adaptogenic properties and is traditionally used to promote overall health and well-being, with reported health benefits including enhanced cognitive function, improved immune response, and antioxidant activity. The therapeutic actions of Schisandra are attributed to its ability to regulate the body's stress response, improve mental clarity, and enhance physical endurance, while its bioactive constituents include lignans, schisandrins, and other phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties. The lignans present in Schisandra are particularly noteworthy for their ability to cross the blood-brain barrier, enabling the plant's bioactive compounds to exert their effects on the central nervous system.
